Perfect! Now I have a comprehensive understanding. Let me compile my findings into a detailed report. ## Video Gallery/Thumbnail Hover Implementation Report I've conducted a thorough exploration of the video gallery implementation in the Vercel website. Here are the complete findings: --- ### 1. COMPONENT ARCHITECTURE **Main Gallery Components:** - **`ProjectGrid.tsx`** - High-level grid container that displays projects - Renders a hero project (full width) + remaining projects in 2-column grid - Uses `ProjectCard` component for each project - Includes perception-based project reordering - **`LadderGrid.tsx`** - Alternative "Golden Ratio Ladder Grid" layout - Scroll-driven fade-up animation (scroll position = animation progress) - Distributes projects across left/right columns with staggered offset - Wraps all cards in `VideoThumbnailManager` - **`ProjectCard.tsx`** - Individual project card wrapper - Contains `VideoThumbnail` component inside a Link - Handles title, description, and client metadata below thumbnail - No overlay or badges on the video itself **Video Management & Playback:** - **`VideoThumbnail.tsx`** - The core thumbnail/hover-to-play component - Static thumbnail image (always visible, muted/desaturated by default) - Vimeo video player loads on mouse enter, auto-plays on hover - Manager-based single-video coordination prevents multiple videos playing - Implements deterministic initialization with 12-second timeout - **`VideoThumbnailManager.tsx`** - Context provider ensuring single active video - Registers/unregisters videos - Stops all other videos when one activates - Prevents race conditions across multiple thumbnails - **`VideoPlayer.tsx`** - Modal and embedded player component - Used for full-screen and project page video displays - Supports public and private (hash-protected) Vimeo videos - **`EmbeddedVideoPlayer.tsx`** - Simple project page video player - Single instance for detail pages --- ### 2. VIMEO INTEGRATION **Video Loading (`lib/vimeo.ts`):** ```typescript // Uses @vimeo/player library export function loadVimeoPlayer() { if (!cachedPlayerImport) { cachedPlayerImport = import('@vimeo/player'); // Cached, single fetch } return cachedPlayerImport.then(m => m.default); } ``` **Player Configuration (in VideoThumbnail.tsx):** ```typescript const baseConfig = { muted: true, loop: true, autoplay: false, controls: false, background: true, responsive: true, title: false, byline: false, portrait: false, dnt: true, playsinline: true }; // Video URL format (supports privacy hashes) const baseUrl = videoHash ? `https://vimeo.com/${videoId}/${videoHash}` : `https://vimeo.com/${videoId}`; const urlWithTime = startTime ? `${baseUrl}#t=${startTime}s` : baseUrl; playerRef.current = new VimeoPlayer(containerRef.current, { url: urlWithTime as `https://vimeo.com/${string}`, ...baseConfig }); ``` --- ### 3. THUMBNAIL HOVER BEHAVIOR **Visual State Transitions:** ```typescript // Static thumbnail layer (always visible)
// Video iframe layer (hidden until ready)
``` **Hover Flow:** 1. User hovers → `handleMouseEnter()` fires 2. Manager activates this video (stops all others) 3. Vimeo player initializes in container (12s timeout) 4. Player plays when ready 5. Video layer opacity transitions to 1 (300ms duration) 6. User leaves → `handleMouseLeave()` pauses and resets --- ### 4. CSS STYLES - POTENTIAL 1PX WHITE LINE SOURCES **Key CSS in `app/globals.css`:** ```css /* Line 205-209: Vimeo iframe background */ iframe[src*="vimeo"], iframe[src*="player.vimeo"] { background-color: #141414; } /* Line 77-79: Border radius for thumbnails */ --radius-md: 6px; /* Used on VideoThumbnail container */ ``` **VideoThumbnail Container:** ```tsx // Outer container style={{ aspectRatio: '16/9', borderRadius: '6px' // ← 6px border radius }} // Static thumbnail div style={{ borderRadius: '6px', // Matches container ... }} // Video container layer style={{ borderRadius: '6px', // Should match, but let me check overflow: 'hidden' // This should clip everything }} ``` **POTENTIAL ISSUE FOUND:** In `VideoThumbnail.tsx` line 327-335, the video layer has these properties: ```typescript
``` **The Problem:** The inner `containerRef` div (where Vimeo injects its iframe) has: - `className="absolute inset-0 w-full h-full"` - **NO explicit `borderRadius` or `overflow: hidden`** The Vimeo iframe injected inside this div won't inherit `overflow: hidden` from the parent, and the borderRadius doesn't cascade to the iframe itself. --- ### 5. LIKELY ROOT CAUSE OF 1PX WHITE LINE **The 1px white line at the top is most likely caused by:** 1. **Vimeo iframe not respecting parent `borderRadius`** - The iframe corners are sharp (0px radius) while the container is rounded (6px), creating a visible hard edge at the top 2. **Anti-aliasing artifact** - At the border-radius junction, especially at the top edge where the contrast is highest 3. **Vimeo player internal padding/margin** - The Vimeo iframe may have subtle padding or border that's white **Where to look:** ```tsx // In VideoThumbnail.tsx, line 337-341
``` --- ### 6. CSS FILES INVOLVED **Active CSS files:** - **`app/globals.css`** - Main design system with: - Color scheme (#141414 dark background) - `--radius-md: 6px` border radius token - Vimeo iframe background color rule - View transition styles - Entrance animations - **`styles/v2-design-system.css`** - Legacy/backup design system (appears to be light theme, not currently active) **Archive CSS (not used):** - `legacy-css/video-hover.css` - `legacy-css/video-player.css` - `legacy-css/sophisticated-video-interactions.css` --- ### 7. CONTAINER STRUCTURE FLOW ``` ProjectGrid / LadderGrid └─ VideoThumbnailManager (context provider) └─ ProjectCard (Link wrapper) └─ VideoThumbnail ├─ Static thumbnail (background-image, always visible) ├─ Video container (opacity-driven reveal) │ └─ containerRef (where Vimeo injects iframe) └─ [on hover] → VimeoPlayer mounts inside containerRef ``` --- ### 8. KEY IMPLEMENTATION DETAILS **Deterministic Initialization:** ```typescript // Timeout-based race condition resolution const readyPromise = playerRef.current.ready(); const timeoutPromise = new Promise((_, reject) => { setTimeout(() => reject(new Error('Initialization timeout')), INIT_TIMEOUT_MS); }); await Promise.race([readyPromise, timeoutPromise]); ``` **Mobile vs Desktop:** ```typescript // Touch device detection function useIsTouchDevice() { const mediaQuery = window.matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)'); // Mobile: static thumbnail only, no hover-to-play // Desktop: full hover-to-play with video layer } ``` **Single Video Enforcement:** ```typescript // Manager.activateVideo() stops ALL others controllersRef.current.forEach((controller, controllerId) => { if (controllerId !== id) { controller.stop(); // Prevents competing playback } }); ``` --- ### 9. LAYOUT.TSX SETUP - Preconnects to Vimeo CDN domains (saves 300-500ms) - Sets `` - Inline style: `html,body{background-color:#141414}` - Schema.org structured data for SEO --- ### SUMMARY The video gallery uses a **sophisticated hover-to-play system** with: - Lazy-loaded Vimeo players (only initialize on hover) - Manager-based single-video coordination - Smooth opacity transitions between thumbnail and video - Deterministic timeouts and abort signal handling The **1px white line issue** is most likely a **border-radius mismatch** between the rounded container and the Vimeo iframe inside it. The fix would involve ensuring the innermost container (where the iframe injects) has proper `borderRadius` and `overflow: hidden` styling.
